notes: WoW Forever launched 2026-11-04 (patch 1.60.1). All three launch raids unlock 2026-12-09 for level 60 and reset weekly: Onyxia's Lair (40), Hyjal Summit (20, 13 bosses), Barrow Deeps (10, 8 bosses).
open_now = whether the unlocked content is accessible today (2026-11-23). The Onyxia attunement chains can already be done now; only the raid is closed until 2026-12-09.

Onyxia's Lair is the only raid with an attunement at launch. Per character, not account-wide 'at least not at launch' (WoW Forever Podcast ep. 3). Amulet in bags, not equipped. Both chains end at General Drakkisath in UBRS.
Sources disagree on Drakkisath's blood: ConquestCapped says it drops for everyone on the quest; LFCarry says limited copies per UBRS clear.

Hyjal Summit and Barrow Deeps: no attunement. Devs: 'there's not something that's going to stop you from walking into them', players 'might have to do a little digging ... to get the full experience', and one new raid has something 'a little familiar' from old attunements. Brooch of the Wardens (item 277136) opens Vord'anaar Prison inside Barrow Deeps; how to get it is unknown.

Molten Core is not a launch raid and has no date; Forever is set before Molten Core's events. 'Attunement to the Core' (7848) and 'Blackhand's Command' (7761) exist in Forever game data only. Roadmap: Spring 2027 two new raids (10 and 20 players); Summer 2027 a 'revamped iconic raid' (unnamed) plus a new raid. Blackwing Lair, Zul'Gurub, Ahn'Qiraj and Naxxramas are not announced. Scarlet Enclave is a confirmed future raid (Warcraft Tavern).

City of Dalaran is the only new dungeon with an entry key (Dalaran Sewer Key, both factions). Hall of Thanes, Ruins of Lordaeron, Excavation Site, The Drowned City, Krol'dok Stronghold, Alcaz Prison, Blackmaw Hold and Shaper's Terrace need no key or attunement to enter. Hall of Thanes 'Underground Map' (Dun Morogh) starts a quest chain but does not gate entry; one search snippet called it an attunement, warcraft.wiki.gg and Warcraft Tavern show no gate.
Hall of Thanes is Alliance-oriented (13-18) and Ruins of Lordaeron Horde-oriented (15-20); the other faction can still enter.

Keys bind on pickup; usually one holder opens the door for the group. Rogue Lockpicking can open Scarlet Monastery, Scholomance, BRD and Dire Maul doors, but not raid attunements or the Dalaran sewer gate.

Many Forever guides for Classic dungeons (BRD, LBRS, Scholomance, Stratholme, Dire Maul, Maraudon, Zul'Farrak) say they are based on Classic because those instances were not in the Forever beta. Wowhead Forever has pages for all classic keys (Workshop Key, The Scarlet Key, Mallet of Zul'Farrak, Scepter of Celebras, Shadowforge Key, Prison Cell Key, Crescent Key, Skeleton Key, Key to the City, Seal of Ascension), so no key is reported removed.
Upper Blackrock Spire group size in Forever: 10 players per most guides, not officially confirmed.
Chipped Drakefire Amulet (account-bound shortcut sold by Squire Rowe / Eitrigg) is a Season of Discovery item; ConquestCapped says it is not on their Forever vendor lists.
The Horde Dalaran quest 'Key to the City' (93680) shares its name with the Stratholme key item; they are unrelated.

Gaps: Brooch of the Wardens source, Azsharan Key use, Krol'dok key doors, exact Forever levels for some Classic chains (Molten Core, Blackhand's Command) and whether Forever retuned any Classic key chain are unverified.
